no: X_23582 is the trilinear pole of line X_107X_110, which is the tangent to the Steiner circumellipse at X_648, and the polar, with respect to the polar circle, of X_125 Line X_107X_110 is also the locus of the trilinear pole of the tangent at P to hyperbola {{A, B, C, X_2, P}}, as P moves on the Euler line.
